molecule.smell: a native browser dialog on a product code path — window.alert / window.confirm / window.prompt, or their bare global forms — where the archetype contracts mandate the app's own surfaces: D2 (settings-table) Layer 7 routes mutation errors through the app-wide toast, and A (list-with-detail) / D2 forbid window.confirm for destructive actions in favor of the shared confirm-dialog primitive. A native dialog breaks the app's visual language, blocks the JS thread, and cannot take a token-pure surface. Ungated by design — the family IS the bare call, so \b is the only guard and the regex deliberately fires on the whole family across any archetype; the narrow co-occurrence-gated window.confirm entries in adoptionQuality (crud-discard-window-confirm, raw-confirm-delete-guard) never see confirm/alert/prompt outside a CRUD discard flow. Line-based, single-file: the call opens on one line, and a window.confirm( whose message string continues onto the next line still trips because the ( sits on the first. Bare alert/confirm/prompt (global calls without the window. prefix) trip too — a globalThis call is the same native dialog, and requiring the prefix would exempt exactly the laziest half of the call sites. Expected residual hits the gate clears: the donor's own src/components/archetypes/crud-dialog/crudStrings.ts confirmDiscard (the J discard guard's demo stand-in, sanctioned house precedent per crud-discard-window-confirm), src/examples/form-page-demo.tsx (demo stand-in, the raw-confirm-delete-guard precedent), the vendored ds-bundle/_ds_bundle.js (donor build artifact — out of scope for a consuming project, which runs the scan on its own src/), and noun collisions like the word prompt in prose/comments (dropzone prompt (…)) that the gate clears by reading the line. Origin: controlling-app archetype-rollout ticket archetype-rollout-native-browser-dialog-scansignal (2026-08-19) filed from frontend-archetype-page-map reconciliation items 3 and 6 — the eight named call sites (AccountsTableView.tsx alerts; PrefixRulesTab/TemplatesTab/scenarios/admin/users/assets/dashboard-templates confirms and prompts) were being re-found by hand on every ritual pass while the co-occurrence-gated crud-discard-window-confirm never saw them, because they live outside a CRUD dialog's discard path

molecule.smell: a matrix-grid (archetype matrix-grid, MatrixGridShell/MatrixGrid consumer) renderCell emits a bare numeric cell figure on its own line — either a direct interpolation `{cell.menge}` or a null-guarded ternary whose whole line reduces to `{ … cell.menge … : null}` — with no `tabular-nums`/`font-mono` styling wrapper, contra matrix-grid acceptance-gate S5 ("all cell figures mono/tabular") and the app-wide tabular-numeral convention every other numeric surface uses (StatTile, KeyValueRow, the vertraege/angebote/tickets tables). The regex covers both drift shapes — a whole-line JSX expression that ends in a `cell.` (optionally `: null`) and carries no `className`. Line-scoped, single-file, no -U slurp (rg -l --pcre2), so it fits molecule (deliberately line-based), not adoptionQuality. Co-occurrence scope lives in this prose, not a coOccursWith field — SignalDef reads only id/regex/shouldUse, so coOccursWith is inert in molecule and the regex has to self-scope; read it on files that also import MatrixGridShell/MatrixGrid, and in practice a `renderCell` is the only place a `cell` binding is in scope. Self-discriminating: the fixed shape wraps the figure — `{cell.menge}` — so the line is no longer a whole-line `{…cell.x}` expression and a remediated cell does not trip; a glyph-only renderCell (matrix-overview-client.tsx: `{meta.glyph}` + sr-only label, never a bare cell figure) never trips; and the `{cell.assignmentCount > 1 ? (` guard lines do not end in `}` so they never trip. Origin: hk-crm archetype-rollout signal proposal (ticket archetype-rollout-signal-matrix-cell-figure-missing-tabular-nums) filed from the 2026-08-15 matrix-grid finding. The two hk-crm consumers were the bare `{cell.menge}` at matrix-bestand-client.tsx and the null-guarded ternary `{cell.menge !== null && cell.menge !== undefined ? cell.menge : null}` at matrix-potenzial-client.tsx, both remediated by hk-crm #772 — the tripwire guards the regression: a future matrix consumer, or a re-hand-rolled edit, that dumps a bare numeric cell figure is caught by scan instead of the next ritual pass. Verified 2026-08-22: the regex matches both pre-#772 shapes, and rg -l --pcre2 over hk-crm src/ returns zero hits (both consumers fixed), zero false positives on design-baseline src/, and no hit on matrix-overview-client.tsx
molecule.shouldBe: wrap the cell figure in the project's tabular-numeral styling — `{cell.field}`, matching every other numeric figure surface (StatTile, KeyValueRow, the vertraege/angebote/tickets tables) — so the figure aligns digit-for-digit and reads as a number, per matrix-grid S5

Every entry is gated by `coOccursWith` (a PCRE alternation of the archetype's shell import names) so it ONLY fires when the file actually adopts that archetype. Regexes are deliberately loose/cheap; false positives are fine because the gate filters them.

adoptionQuality.smell: a B (form-page) page adopts <FormPageShell> without the Layer-2 page-level <ErrorBoundary> — a form that throws during render can tear down the whole route subtree. This is a co-occurrence (presence-of-A + absence-of-B) check that no line-based scanner can express: coOccursWith carries the presence side, and the regex is the whole-file ABSENCE of `ErrorBoundary` anywhere in the file (an import OR a render clears it). The regex anchors at \A (absolute file start — independent of the multiline flag) and `(?:.|\n)*` spans the entire document because `.` does not cross newlines, so it must run SLURP-mode, one file read as a single string (e.g. `rg --pcre2 -U -e 'FormPageShell' -l` for the gate AND `rg --pcre2 -U -l -e \A(?!(?:.|\n)*ErrorBoundary)` per gate-hit, or an equivalent node/python single-string scan). In a line-based scan the file-start anchor is not file-absolute and the absence never evaluates, so the tripwire silently never fires — the gate must confirm the runner is slurp-mode before trusting a clean result. Known residual hits: the primitive's own definition file (names FormPageShell but is not a page-level adoption) and the examples/ demo page — the gate clears both by checking the adopting page, not the shell or the demo
adoptionQuality.shouldBe: wrap the page content — <FormPageShell> + <form> + <FormPageActions>, plus the discard-dialog node where one is rendered — in <ErrorBoundary> at the page-component level, so a render error degrades to the boundary's fallback instead of unmounting the route

The trip is the props-interface field declaration — NOT the `<CrudDialogSheet onOpenChange={(next) => ...}>` internal wiring every conformant dialog carries (a different token shape: `onOpenChange={` vs `onOpenChange:`). Expected residual hits the gate clears: the shell's own props definition (`src/components/archetypes/crud-dialog/CrudDialogSheet.tsx` — its `onOpenChange` IS the sanctioned internal prop each J dialog wraps internally) and the Server-Actions settings-dialog hook (`use-settings-crud-dialog.ts`, the hk-crm ADR-0049 variation — the hook owns the sheet wiring and hand-backs a guarded `onOpenChange` the settings client spreads onto the shell; callers never pass a raw setter through it). Origin: hk-crm archetype-rollout audit 2026-08-20 — gate-decision-dialog.tsx and assign-project-dialog.tsx exposed the raw setter; the named instance is remediated by hk-crm's paired ticket archetype-rollout-gate-decision-dialog-raw-boolean-close-prop (2026-08-20), assign-project-dialog is covered by that ticket's mandated file-sweep bullet
